name: Far Eastern Department Stores, Ltd.
summary: Far Eastern Department Stores, Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, operates department stores and supermarkets in Taiwan. The company offers various products, including general merchandise, silk nylon, cotton cloths, candies cookies, cans, entertainment appliances, hardware, furniture, decorations, handmade products, stationery, library appliances, CD/DVD, camera appliances, children toys, shoe/hat/raining garments, medical equipment, cigarette/wine, rice/corn, salt, beverage, clocks/watches/glasses/cameras and maintenances, and electronic business and maintenance.
